title: Independence Hall (Extremis Malis)
summary: The Philadelphia historical-site setting used by Extremis Malis as a Founders weapons cache and the key evidence location in Caleb Dunne and Heather Ward's investigation.

claims.text: Extremis Malis depicts Independence Hall as a Founders cache where Caleb Dunne and Heather Ward find equipment linking the group to Mantis's operation.
The Division team recovers satellite-communications evidence at the location, shifting the investigation from the Founders toward the wider East Coast network.

paragraphs.text: In the graphic novel's fictional setting, Independence Hall functions as both a weapons cache and an intelligence lead. It is included for its source-specific lore role, not as a depiction of the real site's current condition or operations.

verification.notes: Real-world place name is used solely to describe the licensed fiction's setting; no reproduced art or real-world operational claim is included.
